description: Ask the owner to run a failed or blocked task of your Goal again. Call it from your Run's tool context when your grant includes request_rework and the task's failure should be reworked; the owner runs the same fences as an automatic requeue and does not run the task itself. Under every-step confirmation the call returns a rework-request card instead of performing the rework, and the person's approval applies it as an agent; a committed automatic request is counted in the shared cap. Parameters name the task, the Run whose result the rework follows, and the reason; acknowledgement is set only when this request answers a Session message.

parameters.taskRef.goalId: The task's goal id; it must be your Goal.
parameters.afterRunRef: The Run whose failure or result precedes this rework.
parameters.reason: Why the task should run again; the owner's reason text.
parameters.acknowledgement: The Session message this request answers, when it is an answer to a message; omit otherwise.
parameters.expected: The exact W1 version pins the caller saw for this rework; omit a pin rather than guessing a fresh revision. The Goal and the afterRun are on different `look_graph` cards: read the Goal revision from the Goal card and the Run revision from its own Run card (the Task card's `executions` lists the Run refs). The optional TaskReworkRefusal pin is the current requeue refusal record, when one was shown.
parameters.expected[].ref: One of the caller-visible refs this rework pins: Goal | Run | TaskReworkRefusal (requeue).
parameters.expected[].revision: The exact version the caller saw for `ref`; the owner rejects a mismatch with the current record.
